items.title: Multiple Hacking Groups Exploit OpenClaw Instances to Steal API key and Deploy Malware
items.description: A widespread exploitation of OpenClaw, formerly known as MoltBot and ClawdBot, by multiple hacking groups to deploy malicious payloads. OpenClaw, an open-source autonomous AI framework developed by Peter Steinberger, now at OpenAI, has become a high-severity target following its viral adoption in late January 2026. items.title: Cloudflare Down – 6 Hour of Massive Global Service Outage Cause Customers Unreachable From the Internet
items.description: Cloudflare experienced a significant six-hour global service outage on February 20, 2026, causing major disruptions for customers utilizing its Bring Your Own IP (BYOIP) services. The incident, which began at 17:48 UTC and lasted for six hours and seven minutes, unintentionally withdrew customer BGP routes from the Internet, rendering numerous services and applications unreachable.
